name: Arducam OV9281 1MP Global Shutter Mono Camera (Raspberry Pi)
description: A 1 MP monochrome global-shutter MIPI camera with a NoIR M12 lens. Gives fast (up to 143 fps), skew-free frames for AprilTag/ArUco tracking, visual odometry and IR-illuminated robot vision on a Pi or Jetson.

variants.note: M12 2.8 mm F2.8 lens, 82° diagonal, NoIR

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: RAW8 modes: 1280×800 at 143 fps, 1280×720 at 171 fps, 640×400 at 309 fps. RAW10 is slower (114 fps at full resolution).
No IR-cut filter, so it pairs well with 850 nm IR illumination. Mono output only.
The 22-pin 0.5 mm FPC on the module is the Pi 5/CM pitch. Older Pis need a 22-to-15-pin cable.
